Editing the organisation tables, and the Capabilities page

Pictures of the real platform with the proposed editing drawn in. For the Capabilities page, El Abd's five capabilities are put into the worked example the way El Abd keeps them, so the page shows what you would see on El Abd; the owners are the worked example's people. Nothing here is built yet. The choices are gathered at the bottom.

1 · What can be changed, and where

The shape (under The client) is the outline: which business units, divisions and functions exist, what each is called, how it plans and which division it sits in. The three tables are for running them: codes, the name in the navigation, who heads each one and who keeps its plan, the unit's mark, and what a division's CEO can see.

Three things are on both screens: the name, how it plans, and the division. They're one answer underneath, so changing it on either screen changes it on the other. Nothing can disagree.

Shown on the tables but not changed there: the counts (Key Objectives, Units, Caps) come from the plans, Weight is set on Weighting, and Status changes through ⋮ › Retire.

2 · Double-click a cell, as on the Client register

Today every change on these tables goes through ⋮ › Edit details, a form for the whole row. Proposed: the same as the Client register. Double-click a cell and it opens where it is. Pressing Enter or leaving the cell keeps the change; Esc puts back what was there. Each change is saved as it is made, like the rest of Setup.

Today · the Client register, a cell open

Proposed · Business units, the code open

A person is picked from the same list the form uses

The head and custodian cells open the picker Edit details already has: this unit's people first, then everyone on the Client register, with a search box and Unassign.

Proposed · Functions, how it plans

Proposed · Divisions, what its CEO sees

Switching how something plans when it already has a plan still asks first, as it does today: what it holds is hidden and kept, and switching back brings it back.

3 · The Capabilities page stays, and becomes useful

My earlier suggestion was to remove only this Setup page, never the capabilities: they are pillars of the company plan, and they stay that way either way. You'd like the page kept, so this is how it could earn its place.

On El Abd today

An empty table, then a note that lists the five and says there is nothing to set here. Each owner is printed as a short sign-in key rather than the person's name.

Proposed

A table of the five: the code, the name, the owner, the custodian, and how many key measures and tactics each holds. Double-click the name, owner or custodian to change it. It writes the same pillar the company plan uses, so the plan shows the change at once: one record, two ways to reach it. + Add a capability adds the next one (C006) to the company plan. Removing one stays in the plan, where its measures and tactics are, and asks first. ⋮ on a row opens it in the plan.

What you would be agreeing to

  1. On Business units, Functions and Divisions, a double-click opens a cell where it is, as on the Client register. ⋮ › Edit details stays for the whole row and for the unit's mark.
  2. The Capabilities page is kept and becomes a table you can change: name, owner and custodian on a double-click, and + Add a capability, all writing the company plan's own pillars. Removing one stays in the plan.
  3. Two small fixes on the way: the Capabilities page names owners rather than printing their keys, and the Divisions search box says "Search the divisions" instead of "Search the companies".
